name: Nanami Kyouka
source:
The second oldest of the five Nanami sisters.

She's a sexy, cool woman with a straightforward personality.

You wouldn't guess it from her flashy appearance, but she's also a nurse. She's a caring and reliable older sister, but she also has a bad habit of sexually teasing Riku and Mei... She's usually the family leader, but be careful when she's drunk!

[Translated from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/bokuumi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
